intro.title: Next Greater Element
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that finds the 'next greater element' for each element in an array. The next greater element is the first larger number that appears to the right of a given element. You will learn to implement this using a stack data structure, which helps efficiently track elements as you iterate through the array. The main technologies involved are JavaScript arrays, loops, and conditional logic. By the end, you'll understand how to solve this common algorithmic problem step by step.
intro.usecase: The Next Greater Element algorithm is essential in e-commerce platforms where you need to display 'next higher price' suggestions to users browsing products. For example, when viewing a $50 item, the system can instantly show the next available product priced at $55 without sorting the entire catalog. This pattern powers stock trading dashboards that identify the next higher bid price in real-time order books, and appears in timeline interfaces where you need to find the next scheduled event after a given time. Developers implement this to create responsive filtering systems that efficiently navigate through sorted data like price ranges, time slots, or priority queues.
